source_title: Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit takes charge as new Chief of Air Staff
source_excerpt: New Delhi Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit, a seasoned fighter pilot with over 3,500 hours of flying experience on more than 20 types of aircraft, on Saturday (October 31, 2026) assumed charge as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff, succeeding Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh, who retired after a distinguished career spanning 43 years. Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit is the next Chief of Air Staff storyline 1 The Indian Air Force (IAF) accorded a ceremonial guard of honour to Air Chief Marshal Singh at the Race Course Air Force Station here before he handed over the baton to his successor. Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia named next IAF Vice Chief Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia named next IAF Vice Chief Air Marshal Walia headed the Directorate of Air Staff Inspection (DASI) of the IAF, served as the defence attache at Indian embassies in Japan and South Korea, and was the Senior Air Staff Officer of Eastern Air Command. Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia named next IAF Vice Chief storyline 1 Air Chief Marshal Dixit, who was serving as the Vice Chief of the Air Staff, played a key role in strategic planning during Operation Sindoor. He has held several key commands, staff and instructional appointments during his nearly four-decade-long career in the IAF. Born on December 9, 1966, Air Chief Marshal Dixit was commissioned into the fighter stream of the IAF on December 6, 1986. Before taking over as Vice Chief, he served as the Chief of Integrated Defence Staff to the Chairman, Chiefs of Staff Committee, at Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff. Earlier, he was the Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief of the Central Air Command. Air Force Sports Complex shut as Centre moves to reclaim prime land in Delhi Air Force Sports Complex shut as Centre moves to reclaim prime land in Delhi The closure comes days after the Land and Development Office issued notices to the facility to hand over the land located on Lok Kalyan Marg. Air Force Sports Complex shut as Centre moves to reclaim prime land in Delhi storyline 1 An alumnus of the National Defence Academy, Defence Services Staff College in Bangladesh, and the National Defence College, he is an experimental test pilot and a qualified flying instructor. His extensive flying experience includes aircraft such as the Mirage-2000, MiG variants, Kiran, Jaguar, IL-78, Hawk and Tejas. During his career, he has been associated with several major operations and exercises, including Operation Safed Sagar, Operation Rakshak and Operation Sindoor. He has also commanded a frontline fighter air base in the Western sector and a premier fighter training base in the Southern sector.
